dispatch_inference.basis: Installed Transformers4.57.6 CUDA torch>=2.5 no-explicit-mask branch selects enable_gqa=True without repeatingKV. Qwen uses28 query heads and4KV heads. FP32 flash is unsupported in the tested torch2.6 environment, and efficient dense kernel does not accept the unequal head counts. Tiny actual default dispatch reaches math.
dispatch_inference.evidence_level: Source inference plus measured tiny profiler. This is not a profiler capture of each original long-context OOM call.

Tiny timing is not full-model or autoregressive speed evidence.

protocol.scope: Independent numerical/resource engineering probe, no new sampling, no world, no gradients/optimizer. First2stored oldservice responses plus longest successful stored input; selection by order/length only, notreward. Compare actual original sampling scores to new complete teacher forcing; no claim of oldkernel complete replay or modellearning.
protocol.selection_rule: Selecthigh onlyifall3maxabs<=.02nat and meanabs<=.002nat; else highestifitpasses; else no admitted candidate. OriginalD3threshold unchanged.
protocol.reservation_rule: Reserve34GiB on this authorized shared GPU before CPU weight loading; then release tensor into own allocator cache without empty_cache so model can reuse it. Reset peaks before measured forward. No other process control.

sampling.source: actual generation token IDs and sampling logits, not retokenized text

full_model_teacher_forcing.measurement: Complete model forward over concatenated exact stored input+output token IDs, use_cache=False, logits_to_keep=m+1, temperature0.3 log_softmax followed by gather of each stored output token. Compare to actual original sampled chosen-token log probabilities; no retokenization or new sampling. All original/recomputed/signed arrays remain in the raw report.
full_model_teacher_forcing.selection: Both highest and high pass all3 per-token max<=0.02nat and mean<=0.002nat checks. The predeclared preference selects high. This is numerical candidate admission only.
full_model_teacher_forcing.sequence_delta_caution: The second high sample has signed sequence sum delta=-0.02015421912074089nat. The protocol thresholds per-token max and mean, not the sequence sum; this value is preserved rather than silently subjected to a different criterion.
full_model_teacher_forcing.memory_caution: peak_gpu_bytes is torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated after resetting peaks before each full forward, including loaded model. It excludes allocator reserved memory and does not equal nvidia-smi whole-process footprint. The34GiB startup reservation is a separate loading guard. Old74.87GiB OOM footprint and new29.78–32.05GiB allocated peaks are different measurement scopes, not a matched ratio experiment.
full_model_teacher_forcing.timing_caution: One measured teacher-forcing forward per sample/mode under shared GPU resources, highest first then high. No balanced repeated timing, cache-decoding or end-to-end autoregressive throughput measurement.

profile_change.kv_handling: RepeatKV from4 to28 heads only inside the attention invocation; retain grouped model/cache semantics.
profile_change.backend_policy: Explicit efficient-only SDPA, no silent math/eager/CPU or dtype fallback.
profile_change.mask_semantics: Register the installed SDPA mask interface for the new attention name.
profile_change.high_precision_effect: PyTorch high matmul precision enables CUDA TF32 in the recorded runtime profile; highest records allow_tf32=false. This is an explicit numeric profile change, not evidence that weight dtype changed to BF16.
profile_change.source_scope: Probe source was dirty09e45d9 with stable before/after source hashes. Do not relabel it as the clean formalD1 profile or replace previously frozen run identities.

limits: Exactly3 stored responses selected by order and longest-successful-input, not reward. There is no new rollout success or class support measurement.
The2shorter and1longest-successful historical records do not establish all32k-context, allprompt or allaction probability stability.
No new generation, no gradient update, no optimizer step, no training gain.
No measured original-kernel complete teacher-force rerun; comparison uses originally captured sampling scores.
No measured autoregressive speedup; tiny kernels and teacher-forcing times cannot substitute for it.
No new-service startup/rollout records read or merged into this archive.
No model weights, prompt/token arrays or tensor payloads are copied here. Exact original files and hashes are referenced; /tmp references may expire.
Archive creation performed only file reads/hash checks and wrote this JSON plus its short technical note; no GPU/API/probe rerun.
